name: Something Trainer
source:
This is a re-conceptualization of Something Unlimited in a new engine with a rewritten story, entirely new mechanics, and repurposed, edited, and custom assets. ST is a true trainer game first and foremost, focusing on user choices in capturing, training, or wooing heroines and villainesses.

In this game you play as a recently Pardoned Lex Luthor, intent on rebuilding the criminal empire that's fallen on hard times during your long absence. A recent "project" Roulette has been working on proves to be an idiosyncratic, but highly profitable, way to springboard yourself back to the top and rebuild the Legion. Along the way it gives you an interesting idea to explore regarding Heroines, some Star Labs tech, and the large detention complex in your base.
translation:
这是新引擎中对Something Unlimited的重新概念化，具有重写的故事、全新的机制以及重新调整用途、编辑和自定义的资产。《ST》首先是一款真正的训练游戏，专注于用户在捕捉、训练或吸引女主角和反派方面的选择。

在这款游戏中，你扮演刚刚被赦免的莱克斯·卢瑟，一心想要重建在你长期缺席期间陷入困境的犯罪帝国。Roulette最近正在进行的一个“项目”被证明是一种独特但利润丰厚的方式，可以帮助你重回巅峰并重建军团。一路上，它给了你一个有趣的想法来探索关于女主角、一些星际实验室技术和基地中的大型拘留中心。
